title: The fox burying his grandmother under a hollybush
html_source: This is Stephen’s answer to his own riddle. It is unanswerable by the pupils. Joyce includes it as a mnemotechnic which underlies and triggers thoughts in this episode and all the way up to Circe (Rickard, S. Joyce’s Book of Memory: The Mnemotechnic of Ulysses p145). The obvious example is the internal narrative sequence referring to the fox scraping the ground further down the page.
